description: This file defines the interface EntitiesVersionControlService for version control operations related to entities in the Thingsboard platform, including version saving, listing, comparison, and settings management.

classes.name: EntitiesVersionControlService
classes.description: Interface defining version control operations for entities in Thingsboard.

methods.name: saveEntitiesVersion
methods.description: Saves a version of entities based on the provided request.

methods.name: getVersionCreateStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a version creation request.

methods.name: listEntityVersions
methods.description: Lists versions of a specific entity.

methods.name: listEntityTypeVersions
methods.description: Lists versions of entities of a specific type.

methods.name: listVersions
methods.description: Lists all versions in a branch.

methods.name: listEntitiesAtVersion
methods.description: Lists entities at a specific version and type.

methods.name: listAllEntitiesAtVersion
methods.description: Lists all entities at a specific version.

methods.name: loadEntitiesVersion
methods.description: Loads a specific version of entities.

methods.name: getVersionLoadStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a version load request.

methods.name: compareEntityDataToVersion
methods.description: Compares current entity data to a specific version.

methods.name: listBranches
methods.description: Lists all branches in version control.

methods.name: checkVersionControlAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for version control.

methods.name: autoCommit
methods.description: Performs an automatic commit of an entity or entities.

methods.name: getEntityDataInfo
methods.description: Retrieves data information for an entity at a specific version.
